category_title: Low-attaining students who remain quiet and passive during teacher-directed discussions
scenario_title: Whole-class discussion on multi-digit multiplication arrangements
minimal_context: The student is participating in a whole-class discussion at the end of a mathematics lesson about finding possible arrangements of equal rows for 24 plants.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are finding some possible arrangements of equal rows for 24 plants in a vegetable garden. Riley, what is one way to arrange them?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Puts hand up) I did two 12 times…

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay. What else can you tell us about that?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think happens to the rows if we halve the 12?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits quietly and appears attentive. He does not contribute anything else, making it difficult to conclude whether he is actually listening or simply waiting quietly for the discussion to end.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: We are finding some possible arrangements of equal rows for 24 plants in a vegetable garden. Riley, what is one way to arrange them?

STUDENT: (Puts hand up) I did two 12 times…

TUTOR: Okay. What else can you tell us about that?

STUDENT: That is all.

TUTOR: What do you think happens to the rows if we halve the 12?

STUDENT: (Sits quietly and appears attentive. He does not contribute anything else, making it difficult to conclude whether he is actually listening or simply waiting quietly for the discussion to end.)

task.content: Find some possible arrangements of equal rows for 24 plants in a vegetable garden.
task.learning_goal: Understanding that halving one side of a multiplication expression necessitated the other side 'going up'.

context.environment: Teacher-directed whole-class discussions at the end of mathematics lessons.
context.materials: Board, overhead projector, traffic light system (red, yellow, green).
context.time_context: At the end of a lesson.

challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Sat quietly during the whole-class discussions. Was not observed contributing to any of the whole-class discussions.
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Difficult to conclude whether they were listening or simply waiting quietly for the discussion to end.

behavior_patterns.condition: When making a rare contribution to the discussion.
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Contributions were not more than four words long.
related_quotes: Yeah because I just half… it would be 6 but when I halve 12 that needs to go up
